title: Bunny reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sitting on nothing, just floating in space -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='20' ry='18' fill='#F5E6D3'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='16' fill='#F5E6D3'/>
  <!-- inner ears -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='22' rx='5' ry='16' fill='#F5E6D3' transform='rotate(-10 40 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='22' rx='3' ry='12' fill='#F0A0B0' transform='rotate(-10 40 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='22' rx='5' ry='16' fill='#F5E6D3' transform='rotate(10 60 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='22' rx='3' ry='12' fill='#F0A0B0' transform='rotate(10 60 22)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='45' r='3' fill='#3A3A6A'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='45' r='3' fill='#3A3A6A'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='44' r='1' fill='#B0D0FF'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='44' r='1' fill='#B0D0FF'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='51' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#F0A0B0'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M48 54 Q50 57 52 54' stroke='#D08090' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='36' y1='50' x2='28' y2='48' stroke='#D0C0B0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='36' y1='53' x2='28' y2='54' stroke='#D0C0B0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='64' y1='50' x2='72' y2='48' stroke='#D0C0B0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='64' y1='53' x2='72' y2='54' stroke='#D0C0B0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- arms holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='65' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#F5E6D3' transform='rotate(20 38 65)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='65' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#F5E6D3' transform='rotate(-20 62 65)'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <rect x='30' y='60' width='40' height='28' rx='3' fill='#E04040'/>
  <rect x='32' y='62' width='17' height='24' rx='1' fill='#FFF8F0'/>
  <rect x='51' y='62' width='17' height='24' rx='1' fill='#FFF8F0'/>
  <!-- page lines -->
  <line x1='34' y1='68' x2='47' y2='68' stroke='#C0B0A0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='34' y1='73' x2='47' y2='73' stroke='#C0B0A0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='34' y1='78' x2='47' y2='78' stroke='#C0B0A0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='68' x2='66' y2='68' stroke='#C0B0A0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='73' x2='66' y2='73' stroke='#C0B0A0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='78' x2='66' y2='78' stroke='#C0B0A0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- book spine -->
  <line x1='50' y1='60' x2='50' y2='88' stroke='#B03030' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='94' rx='9' ry='4' fill='#F5E6D3'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='94' rx='9' ry='4' fill='#F5E6D3'/>
  <!-- floof tail hint -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='80' r='5' fill='#FFF0E8'/>
</svg>
